subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` create support initial `content` by writing it immediately, or should supplied `content` be rejected as unsupported?
rationale: Both repair shapes are mechanically small, but they define the user-facing Feishu tool contract and the partial-failure semantics after a document has already been created.

options.title: Support create-time content
options.body: Create the document, write the supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails; this best matches the reporter's expectation.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep create title-only but fail clearly when callers supply `content`, with tests and docs pointing users to create then write.

options.title: Defer the contract choice
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers defer the behavior decision, because silent success with dropped content remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Support create-time content
recommendation.body: Create the document, write the supplied markdown through the existing write path, and preserve created metadata or roll back if the write step fails; this best matches the reporter's expectation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged or authored adjacent Feishu create-contract changes and were already pulled into prior create-with-content discussion.
